answer: A sybil flood hits an agent economy like a gale, but identities are not interchangeable relics. Each new agent posts a work bond, then earns trust through countersigned transactions that peers verify at every epoch. A fresh wallet arriving at the haven gate starts at zero, so cloning is expensive while real work compounds. Reputation decays without activity, and sudden bursts get throttled until peers attest. Proof of labor, not proof of presence, is the gate.
